evidence: Homepage shows 6 template cards each with title, author, description (e.g. Professional Resume by Sarah Chen)
Each card shows title, author, description, category, scenario, usage count, and update date, e.g. Professional Resume / Sarah Chen / Business/Resume / 1,250 uses / Updated 2024-12-01
Clicking Use Template opened a dialog with template details (title, description, author, uses) and a Fill Template tab showing the form fields
Dialog shows 'Required fields missing' banner listing all missing required field names, and 'Preview Result' tab is disabled
All 14 fields (required and optional) accepted typed values successfully
After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and displayed generated resume with all entered values substituted
Preview rendered heading levels (h1 name, h2 sections, h3 job title), emphasis (Jan 2020 - Present in italics), strong text, and a separator; all placeholders replaced with entered values
Preview Result tab was disabled with 'Required fields missing' message until all required fields were filled with valid values, then it became enabled
Markdown template rendered proper headings, strong/emphasis text, and separator after field substitution
Clicking Copy to Clipboard triggered a toast 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.' and the button text changed to 'Copied!'

issue: Email field does not validate format
actual: Entering 'not-an-email' into the required Email field was accepted without error, the Preview Result tab remained enabled, and the preview was generated with the invalid value 'not-an-email' substituted directly into the output instead of being rejected or blocking the preview.

evidence: Field input containing < > { } [ ] \ | ` triggered inline validation error 'Special characters like < > { } [ ] \ | ` are not allowed' and disabled the Preview tab. Separately, input containing markdown control chars (##, **, ---) was accepted but rendered as literal escaped text inside the heading in the preview rather than being re-interpreted as nested markdown, so it did not alter the generated document's structure.
Clicking the heart icon on Professional Resume immediately marked the button active and updated the header 'Favorites' button to show count '1'
Favoriting Professional Resume updated Favorites count to 1; clicking Favorites button opened a favorites-only view showing 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' with only the favorited card
Within favorites-only view, typing 'Resume' in search showed a matching suggestion and correctly filtered the favorited results
Typing 'Resume' showed a real-time suggestion 'Professional Resume'; clicking it filled the search box with 'Professional Resume' and narrowed results to the matching template

Category filter (Resume) narrowed to 1/6, Scenario filter (Academic) narrowed to 1/6, Sort By offers Most Popular/Recently Updated/Oldest First/Alphabetical, and selecting Alphabetical correctly reordered cards alphabetically (Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report)
Category filter, scenario filter, favorites toggle, and sort selection all updated the visible result count ('Showing X of 6 templates') and card order instantly without any page reload

actual: Typing 'Resme' (a one-letter-omission typo of 'Resume') returned 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' with a 'No templates found' message and no suggestions, instead of matching or suggesting 'Professional Resume'.

evidence: Submitting with all text fields blank showed 'Missing required fields' toast; submitting with title/author/description/content filled but no defined field showed 'No fields defined - Please add at least one template field.' toast, both blocking submission

actual: Submitted a template with content containing 3 placeholders ({{hiringManager}}, {{position}}, {{applicantName}}) but only 1 declared field ('Hiring Manager', auto-keyed as {{hiring_manager}}, which doesn't even match any placeholder in the content). The app accepted the submission with a 'Template submitted!' toast and added it to the library instead of blocking submission or requiring the fields/placeholders to reconcile.

evidence: Submitted a custom Markdown template with title, description, author, category, scenario, content, and at least one field; received 'Template submitted!' confirmation
Submitted 'Cover Letter Template' immediately appeared as a new card in the library (7 of 7 templates) and could be opened via 'Use Template', filled, and previewed
Immediately after submission (no reload), the visible count updated from 'Showing 6 of 6 templates' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and the new card rendered in the grid

issue: Duplicate field labels not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Added two separate fields both labeled 'Name' (same placeholder {{name}}) to the Submit Template form. No warning or disambiguation was shown when adding the second duplicate, and clicking Submit Template succeeded with a 'Template submitted!' toast, adding 'Duplicate Field Test' to the library (8 of 8 templates) with the duplicate labels intact and unresolved.

evidence: After a full page reload (navigate to http://localhost:6089/), the Favorites button still shows count '1' (Professional Resume remains favorited), and both previously submitted custom templates ('Cover Letter Template' and 'Duplicate Field Test') still appear in the library, which now shows 'Showing 8 of 8 templates'.
